audience: teams that issue invoices and manage customers and products in AbaNinja

useCases.title: Review invoices, their status and their line items
useCases.text: List the invoices of the account, newest first, with their customer, dates, amounts and status. Open one invoice to see its line items.

useCases.title: Catch up on invoices changed in a set period
useCases.text: Set the updated-since filter to list only the invoices changed recently. Use the list to see what moved since your last check.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and its contacts
useCases.text: List the company and person customers with their customer numbers and contacts. The company list also shows VAT numbers. Open one company to see its addresses, tags and payment terms.

useCases.title: Review products, services and their prices
useCases.text: Filter the products by product key or archived status. Open one product to see its price, tax rate, unit and group.

useCases.title: Check the employees in time tracking
useCases.text: List the active employees with their job titles and employee groups. Switch on the inactive filter to list former employees.
